title: Figures 22–23: Coordinate Transformation by a Ground-Plate Cloak and its implementation
description: Figure 22 shows two grid diagrams: A, a uniform grid with a blue line segment, and B, a grid deformed around a circular region bounded by that segment, captioned "Coordinate Transformation Implemented by a Ground-Plate Cloak." Figure 23 combines a color rendering of an array of I-shaped split-ring resonator cells with a graph of relative refractive index (1 to 2) against a (mm) and a dimensioned unit-cell inset. It is captioned "Figure 23. Implementation of the Ground-Plate Cloak."
